purpose: 通过真实提交入口保存含换行的节点标识及含制表符、清屏字符的版本。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat submit --data-dir fleet-data --receive-time 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < heartbeats.json

purpose: 观察特殊文本显示、真实告警及普通查询保持一行，节点中的字段字样留在引号内。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat health --data-dir fleet-data --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z --node $'节点甲 status=online\nbaseline_seq=999' --expected-version 1.26.0 --tolerated-misses 1
output: node="节点甲 status=online\nbaseline_seq=999" status=online seq=2 collected_at=2026-10-01T11:59:59Z version="1.26.0\t正式版\u001b[2J" height=200 missed=5 findings=[version skew: "1.26.0\t正式版\u001b[2J" != 1.26.0 missed duties above tolerance]

purpose: 观察同一节点的基准查询仅有两行，并保留累计漏签、增量和告警的真实含义。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat health --data-dir fleet-data --at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z --node $'节点甲 status=online\nbaseline_seq=999' --expected-version 1.26.0 --tolerated-misses 2 --missed-since-seq 1
output:
node="节点甲 status=online\nbaseline_seq=999" status=online seq=2 collected_at=2026-10-01T11:59:59Z version="1.26.0\t正式版\u001b[2J" height=200 missed=5 findings=[version skew: "1.26.0\t正式版\u001b[2J" != 1.26.0 missed duties above tolerance]
